title: College Student Retention Risk Analysis From Educational Database using Multi-Task Multi-Modal Neural Fusion

bias_targets.methodology: Using the IBM AI Fairness 360 (AIF360) toolkit to compute bias detection metrics including Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD), Average Odds Difference (AOD), and Disparate Impact (DI) for dropout predictions, specifically evaluating with 'Male' designated as the privileged group.
